verdict.rationale: Built-in search analytics is a fair question for a search engine or search service like Orama. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents query analytics, no-result query tracking, or click-through reporting. The pack covers search features (full-text, vector, hybrid, facets, merchandising), Cloud data sources, and an MCP server, none of which deliver this story.

support.subject: As a founder, built-in analytics show top queries, no-result queries, and click-through so I know what users search for and miss
